recentItems.title: Inside Houthi's War Machine, How Poor Yemen Fuels Billions Of Dollars For Rebels To Fight Saudi
recentItems.description:
What keeps an armed movement like Yemen's Houthis fighting for more than a decade? Well, the answer is not just Iranian weapons, missile technology or military training. It is actually an expanding financial empire built inside one of the poorest countries in the Arab world. So How have the Houthis built this financial empire? How does money collected from ordinary Yemenis reach the battlefield? And who is paying the price? Well come along and watch this edition of From The News Desk with Yash Goyal till the end, because the biggest revelation is not simply how the Houthis raise money, but how they have turned Yemen's struggling economy into a financial lifeline for war.
